status: DRAFT, unsigned. Lab-written vectors for a lab draft; not a standard.
round: fold, 2026-11-13: one or more vectors per item of the clean-room measurer's gap list that a vector can state; field `gap` names the item
id_rule: sha256 of the UTF-8 canonical text (section 3) of {op, inputs}; an input string with no canonical form is replaced inside the id object by {utf16be_hex: its UTF-16BE code units in lowercase hex}

expect_rule.hand: rows and refusals as the text gives them; core_digest is check_v0's, recorded only after its rows matched expect_rows
expect_rule.jcs: section 3's canonical text or refusal code, the value read by 6.13
